question: 86 + 33 - (29 div 1) + 22 times 1 + 44 - 16 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve using the BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

Evaluate the division and multiplication first: 29 ÷ 1 = 29 and 22 × 1 = 22.

Simplify the expression: 86 + 33 − 29 + 22 + 44 − 16.

Group positive and negative numbers: (86 + 33 + 22 + 44) − (29 + 16) = 185 − 45 = 140.

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 86 + 33 − (29 ÷ 1) + 22 × 1 + 44 − 16

Method: Apply BODMAS rule

⇒ 86 + 33 − 29 + 22 × 1 + 44 − 16 (Solving Bracket & Division)

⇒ 86 + 33 − 29 + 22 + 44 − 16 (Solving Multiplication)

⇒ 119 − 29 + 22 + 44 − 16

⇒ 90 + 22 + 44 − 16

⇒ 112 + 44 − 16

⇒ 156 − 16

⇒ 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

This rule defines the order of operations: Brackets (), Orders (powers/square roots), Division (÷), Multiplication (×), Addition (+), and Subtraction (−).

Multiplication and Division Identity

Any number divided by 1 or multiplied by 1 remains unchanged (n ÷ 1 = n and n × 1 = n).

Addition and Subtraction Grouping

To simplify long calculations, group all positive terms together and all negative terms together before finding the final difference.
